measurement: host monotonic clock immediately before a new pinned-key SSH exec until the actual CLI turn.started (Codex) or system/init (Claude) event is read; includes SSH overhead; VM and fixed reverse forward already prepared
cache_condition: fresh private VM per adapter; immutable pinned agent closure; five new CLI/SSH sessions reuse that VM and its private home; OS caches not flushed
transport: no NIC/TSI; existing fixed vsock SSH port; guest-only loopback 443 is forwarded by trusted OpenSSH client to exactly one vendor:443; immutable hosts aliases preserve real server name; TLS validation runs inside guest
credentials: only deliberately invalid test keys; no real login/host credential import
positive_controls: verified HTTPS from guest to actual vendor returning 401
actual CLI initialization event plus vendor 401 for every repetition
negative_controls: wildcard, wrong and dynamic reverse ports refused
normal production keeper refuses all reverse forwarding by default

Each actual CLI reaches a live TLS endpoint with correct vendor SNI and a self-signed certificate. Codex sends an unknown-CA alert. Claude sends no application bytes with default trust and does send application bytes to the exact same endpoint when its public test CA is explicitly added in that child process; its retry loop is stopped under five-second supervision.
interpretation: startup and dummy-key transport only; not a completed authenticated agent task; no concurrent-agent-density or production credential-channel qualification
comparison_rule: any valid initialization sample above accepted five-second limit fails the startup row; failures and incomplete rows retained

revisions.reason: Pilot showed the upstream rejects absent SNI before sending a certificate. Use an unrelated valid trust root with the correct SNI to test the client validator directly. Virtual HTTPS port is standard 443, preserving HTTP authority; nonstandard authority also timed out in the direct host control. No accepted E5 threshold changed.

Codex uses bundled roots and did not honor replacing SSL_CERT_FILE; this is not a TLS validation failure. Replace the ineffective environment override with an actual self-signed server at the correct hostname. Startup thresholds unchanged.

Pilot established that Bun completes the cryptographic handshake before dropping the connection without application data and reconnects without a final error. Verify default-trust versus explicit-test-CA behavior on the same endpoint; record SNI, byte counts and supervised stop. No TLS bypass observed. Startup threshold unchanged.
